items.title: Parallel agents without worktrees: which route
items.judge: Three routes to a second agent on a build without a second worktree, each costed in the sheet: (1) the sidecar - already built, five row fields on one build, touches neither the engine nor the compiler; (2) saved states - a named, restorable, diffable snapshot of a build's inputs plus the engine revision, four of its seven parts already on disk, about 3-4 slices, makes engine work reversible but not parallel; (3) per-agent engine copies - 12 scripts hardcode the engine path, the inliner gains a second target, the species modules still collide, and the two 13,806-line engines merge by hand without git. Which route do we take?
